title: QUIZ - 73
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Interpreting Function Notation
questions.learningObjective: Interpret what f(n) notation represents
questions.question: What does the notation \( g(16) \) mean?

options.label: B
options.text: The variable 16 raised to the power g.

options.label: C
options.text: The output of function g when the input is 16.

options.label: D
options.text: The input value of function g.

questions.explanation: \( g(16) \) means "evaluate the function g at the input 16"; it represents the resulting output value, not multiplication.
questions.hint: Track what the symbol before the parentheses names and what the value inside the parentheses specifies.

questions.concept: Identifying the Role of the Input Variable
questions.learningObjective: Identify the role of the variable inside function notation
questions.question: In the expression \( g(t) = 7t + -6 \), what does t represent?

options.label: A
options.text: A fixed constant that never changes.

questions.explanation: In g(t), t is the placeholder for whatever input value is substituted into the function.
questions.hint: The letter inside the parentheses in function notation always represents the input.

questions.concept: Converting Between y= and Function Notation
questions.learningObjective: Rewrite an equation in y= form using function notation
questions.question: Rewrite the equation \( y = 3n - 15 \) using function notation g(n).
questions.explanation: Function notation replaces y with g(n), giving g(n) = 3n - 15.
questions.hint: Replace y with f(x) (or the appropriate function name and variable) on the left side of the equation.
